notes: Cheque range is a planning estimate. Confirm partner coverage for applied AI in marketing.

notes: Cheque range is a planning estimate. Publishes public roadmaps and theses - read before the first call.

name: Emergence Capital

name: Craft Ventures
thesis_summary: Early-stage B2B SaaS and marketplace firm with a strong operating and go-to-market orientation.
notes: Cheque range is a planning estimate.

name: Costanoa Ventures

notes: Strong stage fit for a seed round. Cheque range is a planning estimate.

name: Bowery Capital
thesis_summary: Seed firm organised explicitly around go-to-market technology and enterprise sales enablement.
notes: Thesis is close to the go-to-market decisioning framing. Confirm current fund is actively deploying.

name: Forerunner Ventures

notes: Best fit for the CPG and consumer-commerce expansion narrative rather than the restaurant wedge.

name: Cleveland Avenue
thesis_summary: Food, beverage and restaurant-technology specialist founded by former restaurant operators.
notes: Sector specialist with operator credibility. Confirm whether they invest in software as well as brands.

name: Nexus Venture Partners
thesis_summary: India and US dual-presence firm that regularly backs US-incorporated enterprise software companies.
notes: One of the clearest India-US corridor funds for US-incorporated B2B software.

name: Peak XV Partners
thesis_summary: Large India and Southeast Asia multistage platform that backs cross-border software companies.
notes: Also runs the Surge programme - see the programmes tab. Confirm mandate for a US-incorporated entity.

name: Together Fund
thesis_summary: Operator-led fund focused on India-origin B2B SaaS companies selling into the US market.
notes: Explicitly cross-border thesis. Strong stage fit for a seed round.

name: Stellaris Venture Partners
thesis_summary: Early-stage India firm with a growing enterprise AI and SaaS practice.
notes: Confirm appetite for a US-incorporated company with a US-only customer base.

name: Prime Venture Partners
thesis_summary: Early-stage India firm that backs B2B software companies, including those selling primarily to US buyers.
notes: Cheque range is a planning estimate.

name: Avataar Venture Partners
thesis_summary: Growth-stage firm focused on go-to-market scaling for cross-border B2B software companies.
notes: Growth stage - out of range for a seed round, kept as a future-round relationship to warm up early.
